answer: The Indian plastic industry is one of the fastest-growing sectors in the country, acting as a major contributor to the national economy and manufacturing ecosystem. India has a vast consumer base driving high demand across packaging, agriculture, construction, and electronics. The sector comprises numerous micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) alongside major petrochemical complexes, positioning India as a prominent global manufacturing and export hub for plastics.
